name: AI Workspace
description: Enterprise-grade, per-user AI chat workspace with full persistence, streaming (SSE), and provider-agnostic model selection via the Drupal AI module.

suggests.drupal/ai_assistant_api: Enables assistant-backed threads (assistant__<id> model keys) that run through the AI Assistant API runner with its own system prompt, tools and history.

project_description: AI Workspace is a per-user, persistent, ChatGPT-style chat interface built inside Drupal on top of the Drupal AI module. Each authenticated user gets a private workspace with multiple named conversation threads, stored as Drupal content entities (ai_workspace_thread + ai_workspace_message) owned by the creating user. Responses stream token-by-token to the browser over Server-Sent Events, model/provider selection is agnostic (any chat-capable provider configured in the AI module), and thread titles are auto-generated by the AI after the first exchange. The front-end is a React (assistant-ui) single-page app mounted on one Drupal route (/ai_workspace by default, configurable) that talks to a JSON+SSE REST API under /api/ai-workspace. Optional integration with ai_assistant_api lets a thread run an AI Assistant (assistant__<id> keys) through that module's runner. A settings form (/admin/ai/workspace, permission 'administer ai workspace') configures the default model, an allow-list of providers, a global system prompt, starter suggestions, appearance strings, per-user thread caps, tool calling and audit logging. A pluggable tool-calling scaffold (AiWorkspaceTool plugin type) is present but ships no active tools in this release. Marked not-covered by the Drupal security advisory policy and described upstream as under active development.
